name: current_employee_id
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_employee_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select id from employees where auth_id = auth.uid() limit 1;
$function$

name: fn_contract_cancel_holds
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_contract_cancel_holds(p_contract_id text, p_member_id text, p_why text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_n  int;
  v_op text := coalesce(current_employee_id(), '系統／直連');
begin
  if p_contract_id is null then return 0; end if;
  update bookings
     set status = 'cancelled',
         cancelled_at = now(),
         cancelled_by = case when current_employee_id() is not null then current_employee_id() else cancelled_by end,
         cancel_reason = p_why || '｜操作者 ' || v_op
   where contract_id = p_contract_id
     and pending_contract is true and ticket_id is null
     and status::text <> 'cancelled'
     and member_id is not distinct from p_member_id;
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return v_n;
end
$function$

name: fn_contracts_delete_cascade
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_contracts_delete_cascade()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_n int;
begin
  perform 1 from ticket_grant_requests r where r.contract_id = old.id for update;
  v_n := public.fn_contract_cancel_holds(old.id, old.member_id,
           '合約刪除連動（合約 ' || old.id || '）自動取消未轉正卡位');
  update ticket_grant_requests
     set status = 'cancelled',
         cancel_reason = coalesce(nullif(cancel_reason, ''), '合約被刪除'),
         reviewed_at = coalesce(reviewed_at, now())
   where contract_id = old.id and status = 'pending';
  return old;
end
$function$

name: fn_log_change
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_log_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.change_log(tbl,row_id,op)
  values (tg_table_name,
          coalesce((case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.id else new.id end), '')::text,
          left(tg_op,1));
  return null;
end $function$

name: fn_tk_holding
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_tk_holding(p_ticket text, p_exclude text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(booking_id text, bdate date, bstatus text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select b.id, b.date, b.status::text
    from bookings b
   where b.status::text is distinct from 'cancelled'
     and b.id is distinct from p_exclude
     and ( b.ticket_id = p_ticket
           or b.id in ( select l.booking_id from ticket_logs l
                         where l.ticket_id = p_ticket and l.booking_id is not null
                         group by l.booking_id
                        having coalesce(sum(case when l.action::text = 'deduct' then 1
                                                 when l.action::text = 'refund' then -1 else 0 end), 0) > 0 ) )
$function$

name: fn_tk_is_unopened
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_tk_is_unopened(t member_tickets)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ select coalesce(t.valid_days, 0) > 0 and t.activated_at is null and t.start_date is null and t.expire_date is null $function$

name: fn_tk_window_check
is_staff_desk
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff_desk()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ select current_staff_role() in ('admin','front_desk')
   or exists(select 1 from employees e where e.auth_id=auth.uid()
       and e.role='coach' and coalesce(e.is_manager,false) and e.status is distinct from 'inactive'); $function$
